name.zh: 勇者之塔 神秘领域 谱尼

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔 神秘领域

reward_note: No reward (4399: 神秘领域 谱尼 无奖励). The capture line of 谱尼 (seals) is a separate encounter set (boss_puni_*).

capture.zh: 神秘领域需要带上6只100级精灵才能进入；对手是???级的谱尼，打赢没有奖励。

strategy_notes.zh: 闪光波克尔减命中、减速度，艾斯菲亚减技能PP，依卡莱恩寄生种子吸到无血。

engine_notes: Entry requirement: exactly six pets, all Lv100 (需要带上6只100级精灵才能进入). Encoded as rule player_team_size {min:6,min_level:100} and unlock.entry; the vocabulary's player_team_size only has max.
Level '???' (above 100); 150 is a placeholder. HP not published; 3000 is an estimate. Percentage drain (寄生种子) and stat/PP drain worked.
This is the pre-seal 谱尼 of the 2009-2010 神秘领域, not the 七重封印 capture line written by another worker.
Unlock after 60F is assumed (the source lists it after 60F); the 谱尼 seal line was entered from the same 神秘领域 via the lamps beside the tower.
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔攻略 (2010-04-13), 神秘领域 row: 谱尼 ???级 圣光系, 无奖励, 需6只100级精灵.
